story.story:
Little Red Riding Hood’s mother tucked bread and a small cake into a wicker basket. “Take these to Grandmother’s cottage, and stay on the forest path.” Red tied her scarlet hood and set off.

Under an oak tree, a wolf stepped onto the path. “Where are you going?” he asked.

“To Grandmother’s cottage beside the three birch trees,” Red replied.

“Why not bring her flowers?” suggested the wolf. While Red picked daisies, he raced ahead.

At the cottage’s green front door, the wolf knocked and called in a sweet voice, “It’s Little Red Riding Hood!”

“Lift the latch,” Grandmother answered from bed.

The wolf rushed inside and swallowed her whole. He put on her nightcap, pulled her quilt over himself, and waited.

Red arrived, pushed open the green door, and placed her basket on the wooden table. She approached the bed.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red gripped her cloak. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf sprang up. Red screamed, but he swallowed her whole. Then he fell asleep, snoring loudly.

A passing woodcutter heard the snores and entered through the green door. Seeing the wolf’s swollen belly, he carefully snipped it open. Red scrambled out, then helped Grandmother climb free. Trembling with relief, they hugged.

They filled the sleeping wolf’s belly with stones. When he awoke, he stumbled and fell dead.

Grandmother shared the cake with her rescuers. Red promised never to wander from the path again.

blocking.title: Little Red Riding Hood
blocking.style: Watercolor and colored-pencil storybook illustrations; woodland greens, warm cream, and a scarlet cloak; soft morning sunlight outdoors, cool shadows inside the cottage, and warm light after the rescue.

entities.name: Stones placed in the wolf’s belly

blocking.story:
Little Red Riding Hood’s mother tucked bread and a small cake into a wicker basket. “Take these to Grandmother’s cottage, and stay on the forest path.” Red tied her scarlet hood and set off.

Under an oak tree, a wolf stepped onto the path. “Where are you going?” he asked.

“To Grandmother’s cottage beside the three birch trees,” Red replied.

“Why not bring her flowers?” suggested the wolf. While Red picked daisies, he raced ahead.

At the cottage’s green front door, the wolf knocked and called in a sweet voice, “It’s Little Red Riding Hood!”

“Lift the latch,” Grandmother answered from bed.

The wolf rushed inside and swallowed her whole. He put on her nightcap, pulled her quilt over himself, and waited.

Red arrived, pushed open the green door, and placed her basket on the wooden table. She approached the bed.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red gripped her cloak. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf sprang up. Red screamed, but he swallowed her whole. Then he fell asleep, snoring loudly.

A passing woodcutter heard the snores and entered through the green door. Seeing the wolf’s swollen belly, he carefully snipped it open. Red scrambled out, then helped Grandmother climb free. Trembling with relief, they hugged.

They filled the sleeping wolf’s belly with stones. When he awoke, he stumbled and fell dead.

Grandmother shared the cake with her rescuers. Red promised never to wander from the path again.

asset_specs.name: Little Red Riding Hood
asset_specs.height: A small child, about half the height of a grown person.
asset_specs.spec: Red is a slender young girl with warm fair skin, round cheeks, a small nose, and large brown eyes. Her dark chestnut hair has a short straight fringe and two braids reaching just below her shoulders. She wears a warm cream calf-length dress, a sage-green apron, cream stockings, and brown ankle boots. Her defining garment is a scarlet knee-length cape with a roomy rounded hood, fastened beneath her chin with two scarlet ties.

asset_specs.name: Red’s mother
asset_specs.height: An average-height grown woman, roughly twice Red’s height.
asset_specs.spec: Mother has an average build, warm fair skin, an oval face, hazel eyes, and softly arched brown eyebrows. Her chestnut-brown hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a neat low bun. She wears a moss-green long-sleeved dress reaching her ankles, a plain warm cream apron tied at the waist, and dark brown leather shoes.

asset_specs.name: Bread
asset_specs.height: A small loaf about 20 centimeters long, held comfortably in two grown hands.
asset_specs.spec: The bread is a plump oval loaf with a gently domed top and a flat underside. Its golden-brown crust has three diagonal scoring marks and a slightly darker lower edge. It is whole, without slices or wrapping.

asset_specs.name: Small cake
asset_specs.height: About 12 centimeters across and 6 centimeters tall, small enough to rest on one grown palm.
asset_specs.spec: The cake is a small round sponge cake with straight sides and a shallow domed top. It has a warm golden surface, pale buttery sides, and a narrow darker-brown rim around its base. It is plain and whole, without icing, candles, decorations, or wrapping.

asset_specs.name: Wicker basket
asset_specs.height: About 35 centimeters wide and 22 centimeters deep, with a handle that allows it to be carried in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The basket is an open oval wicker basket woven from honey-brown willow strips, with a flat base and gently flaring sides. A thick braided rim surrounds the opening, and one sturdy arched handle runs between the two short ends. It has no lid, lining, ribbon, or decoration.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother
asset_specs.height: A short elderly grown woman, about one and a half times Red’s height.
asset_specs.spec: Grandmother is a slender elderly woman with a gently stooped posture, fair skin, a narrow softly wrinkled face, blue-gray eyes, and a small rounded nose. Her silver-white hair is gathered into a low bun, with a few soft wisps beside her temples. She wears a loose warm cream nightdress with long sleeves and narrow sage-green stitching at the collar and cuffs. Her white cotton nightcap has a rounded gathered crown, a narrow ruffled brim, and two white ties fastened beneath her chin.

asset_specs.name: Wolf
asset_specs.height: A large natural wolf, about waist-high to a grown person when standing on all fours.
asset_specs.spec: The wolf is a natural four-legged animal with a long lean body, a deep chest, strong legs, large paws, and a thick bushy tail; he normally walks on all fours and wears no clothing. His fur is charcoal gray along the back and tail, medium gray on the flanks, and warm pale gray on the chest, belly, and muzzle. He has tall pointed ears, large amber eyes beneath dark brows, a long tapered muzzle, a black nose, and prominent ivory canine teeth.

asset_specs.name: Daisies picked by Red
asset_specs.height: Each flower is about a handspan tall; the group is small enough to gather in one child’s hand.
asset_specs.spec: These are common field daisies with small round golden-yellow centers surrounded by narrow white petals. Their slender fresh-green stems carry a few small elongated leaves. The flowers vary slightly in height and have no ribbons, wrapping, or other decoration.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother’s nightcap
asset_specs.height: An adult-sized cap with a crown about one handspan high.
asset_specs.spec: The nightcap is made of plain white cotton with a soft, rounded crown gathered into a narrow ruffled brim. Two narrow white fabric ties extend from the lower sides. It has no lace, embroidery, colored trim, or pompom.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother’s quilt
asset_specs.height: A single-bed quilt, long and wide enough to cover one grown person.
asset_specs.spec: The quilt is a thick rectangular cotton patchwork cover made from equal-sized squares in warm cream, muted sage green, and faded rust red. The squares repeat in a regular alternating pattern, with visible cream quilting stitches forming small diamonds. A solid sage-green binding finishes all four edges, and the underside is plain warm cream.

asset_specs.name: Woodcutter
asset_specs.height: A tall grown man, about a head taller than Mother.
asset_specs.spec: The woodcutter is a broad-shouldered, sturdy man with warm fair skin, a square face, brown eyes, and a short chestnut beard and mustache. His chestnut hair is cropped short and slightly wavy. He wears a moss-green long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled to his forearms, dark brown trousers held by tan suspenders, and heavy dark brown leather boots.

asset_specs.name: Stones placed in the wolf’s belly
asset_specs.height: Six stones, each roughly the size of a grown person’s fist and able to fit in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The stones are six solid, rounded fieldstones with irregular oval shapes and gently flattened sides. Their surfaces are dull gray and gray-brown, with small ochre speckles and occasional pale mineral veins. They have softly worn edges rather than sharp points and bear no markings or decoration.
